name: Turanci don Rayuwar Yau da Kullum (ESL)

Idan ba ku fahimci abin da wani ya faɗa ba, neman mutumin ya maimaita, ya yi magana a hankali ko ya faɗi haruffan kalma da jimlar Turanci mai ladabi, maimakon yin kamar kun fahimta
A cikin shago, tambayar inda wani abu yake, tambayar farashi da faɗin yadda za ku biya, ta amfani da jimloli daga darasin
A ofishin likita ko a waya, faɗin abin da ke damunku da tsara ganawa a rana da lokacin da suka dace da ku, kuna ba da sunanku, matsalar da lokacin, kuma kuna maimaita lokacin

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Haɗuwa da mutane da sayayya

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Gaisuwa da gabatar da kanku
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Gabatar da kanku a gajerun jimloli uku, sannan ku yi tambaya ɗaya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kun haɗu da sabon mutum, za ku iya gabatar da kanku a Turanci da sunanku, inda kuka fito da abin da kuke yi, sannan ku yi tambaya ɗaya, a cikin aƙalla gajerun jimloli uku.
Idan kun haɗu da sabon mutum, ku fara da gaisuwa: "Hello." ko "Hi." Da safe kuna iya cewa "Good morning." Sannan ku faɗi sunanku: "My name is Ana." ko "I'm Ana."
Ku ƙara inda kuka fito da abin da kuke yi: "I'm from Guatemala." "I work at a restaurant." "I'm looking for a job." Sannan ku yi tambaya: "What's your name?" "Where are you from?" Idan sun amsa, ku ce "Nice to meet you."
Misalin hira. A: "Hi, I'm Ana. What's your name?" B: "I'm Sam. Nice to meet you." A: "Nice to meet you too. I'm from Guatemala. I work at a restaurant." B: "Oh, which one?"
Ba ku buƙatar dogayen jimloli. Gajerun jimloli uku masu sarari gabatarwa ce mai ƙarfi. Ku yi murmushi, ku kalli mutumin, kuma ku yi magana kaɗan a hankali.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku gaishe: "Hello." ko "Good morning."
- Ku faɗi sunanku: "My name is ..." ko "I'm ..."
- Ku faɗi inda kuka fito: "I'm from ..."
- Ku faɗi abin da kuke yi: "I work at ..." ko "I'm looking for a job."
- Ku yi tambaya ɗaya: "What's your name?" Sannan ku ce "Nice to meet you."
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "I'm": gajeriyar hanyar cewa "I am" (ni ne / ina).
- "Nice to meet you": jimla mai ladabi da kuke faɗa idan kun haɗu da wani a karon farko (na yi farin cikin haɗuwa da ku).
- Gabatar da kanku: faɗa wa sabon mutum ko ku wane ne.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USA Learns: kwasa-kwasan Turanci kyauta ga manya (Sacramento County Office of Education)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta gabatarwarku: sunanku, inda kuka fito da abin da kuke yi, a gajerun jimloli uku. Ku ƙara tambaya ɗaya da za ku yi. Ku karanta ta da babbar murya sau uku. Sannan ku faɗe ta ba tare da kallon takardar ba.
Yanzu za ku iya gabatar da kanku a gajerun jimlolin Turanci uku, da yi wa sabon mutum tambaya.

check.q: Wani ya ce "Nice to meet you." Mene ne amsa mai kyau?
check.why: "Nice to meet you too" ita ce amsa mai ladabi idan kun haɗu da wani.

check.q: Wace gabatarwa ce ke da suna, inda aka fito da abin da ake yi?
options: "I'm Ali. I'm from Somalia. I drive a truck."
check.why: Tana ba da suna, ƙasa da aiki a gajerun jimloli uku.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Neman mutum ya maimaita, ya yi a hankali ko ya faɗi haruffa
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Neman mutum ya maimaita, ya yi magana a hankali ko ya faɗi haruffan kalma da jimla mai ladabi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan ba ku fahimci abin da wani ya faɗa ba, za ku iya neman mutumin ya maimaita, ya yi magana a hankali ko ya faɗi haruffan kalma da jimlar Turanci mai ladabi, maimakon yin kamar kun fahimta.
Kowa yakan kasa jin wasu kalmomi wani lokaci, har ma waɗanda Turanci harshensu na asali ne. Abu ne na yau da kullum kuma mai ladabi a tambaya. Ya fi kyau sosai da cewa "yes" alhali ba ku fahimta ba.
Jimloli masu amfani: "Sorry, can you repeat that, please?" "Can you speak more slowly, please?" "How do you spell that?" "What does that word mean?" "Can you write it down, please?"
Don tabbatar da cewa kun fahimta, ku maimaita abin da aka faɗa: "So, Tuesday at 3 o'clock?" Idan sashe ɗaya kawai kuka rasa, ku tambayi game da wannan sashen: "Sorry, what time?"
Misalin hira. A: "Your pickup is at the side entrance at four fifteen." B: "Sorry, can you speak more slowly, please?" A: "Side entrance. Four fifteen." B: "So, the side door at 4:15?" A: "Yes, that's right."
Mataki-mataki:
- Kada ku yi kamar kun fahimta.
- Ku ce "Sorry," sannan ku nemi a maimaita, a yi a hankali, a faɗi haruffa ko a rubuta.
- Ku maimaita muhimmin sashen don tabbatarwa.
- Ku jira "Yes, that's right."
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Repeat": sake faɗa.
- "Slowly": a hankali, ba da sauri ba.
- "Spell": faɗin haruffan kalma ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta jimloli huɗu na neman taimako a ƙaramin kati, ku ajiye shi a aljihunku ko a wayarku. Ku karanta kowanne da babbar murya sau biyar. Sannan ku kunna tashar rediyo ta hira ko bidiyo, kuma duk lokacin da kuka kasa jin wani abu, ku faɗi ɗaya daga cikin jimlolin da babbar murya.
Yanzu za ku iya neman mutum ya maimaita, ya yi a hankali, ya faɗi haruffa ko ya rubuta kalma, da maimaita abin da kuka ji don tabbatarwa.

check.q: Wani ma'aikaci yana magana da sauri sosai kuma ba ku ji ba. Me za ku ce?
check.why: Neman mutumin ya yi magana a hankali yana da ladabi kuma yana ba ku bayanin.

check.q: Nas ta faɗi sunan likitanku kuma ba za ku iya rubuta shi ba. Me za ku tambaya?
check.why: "How do you spell that?" yana neman haruffan don ku iya rubuta sunan.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Sayayya: neman kaya, farashi da biyan kuɗi
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tambayar inda wani abu yake, tambayar farashi da faɗin yadda za ku biya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A cikin shago, za ku iya tambayar inda wani abu yake, tambayar farashi da faɗin yadda za ku biya, ta amfani da jimloli daga darasin.
Don neman wani abu, ku ce "Excuse me" sannan ku tambaya: "Where can I find the rice?" ko "Do you have diapers?" Ma'aikacin yana iya cewa "Aisle 5" (layin shago mai lamba) ko "Sorry, we're out of it." (ya ƙare).
Don tambayar farashi: "How much is this?" ko "How much are these?" idan abu fiye da ɗaya ne. A wurin biya, mai karɓar kuɗi yana iya tambaya: "Cash or card?" "Do you want a bag?" "Do you want your receipt?" Ku amsa: "Card, please." "No bag, thanks." "Yes, please."
Ku ajiye rasiɗinku. Don mayar da wani abu, ku ce: "I'd like to return this, please. Here is my receipt." Kowane shago yana da nasa ƙa'idojin mayar da kaya, don haka kuna iya tambaya: "What is your return policy?"
Misalin hira. A: "Excuse me, where can I find the milk?" B: "In the back, next to the eggs." A: "Thanks. How much is this?" B: "Three ninety-nine." A: "Okay. Card, please."
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku ce "Excuse me" don neman taimako.
- Ku tambaya "Where can I find ...?"
- Ku tambaya "How much is this?"
- A wurin biya ku amsa "Cash or card?" da "Do you want a bag?"
- Ku ajiye rasiɗin don mayar da kaya.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Aisle": layi a cikin shago mai shiryayyu a gefe biyu. Ana faɗinsa kamar "I'll".
- "Receipt": takardar da ke nuna abin da kuka saya da abin da kuka biya (rasiɗi). Ba a faɗin harafin p.
- "Return": mayar da abu shago don a dawo muku da kuɗinku.
- "Cashier": ma'aikacin da ke karɓar kuɗinku a wurin biya.
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi wasan kwaikwayo da abokin atisaye, ko ku yi dukan sassan biyu da babbar murya: kuna cikin shagon kayan abinci. Ku tambayi inda abubuwa biyu suke, ku tambayi farashin ɗaya, ku amsa tambayoyi uku na mai karɓar kuɗi. Idan kun je sayayya a gaba, ku yi amfani da jimla ɗaya da gaske.
Yanzu za ku iya tambayar inda wani abu yake a shago, tambayar farashi, amsa wa mai karɓar kuɗi da neman mayar da wani abu.

check.q: Kuna son sanin farashin riguna biyu. Me za ku tambaya?
check.why: "How much are these?" yana tambayar farashin abu fiye da ɗaya.

check.q: Mai karɓar kuɗi ta tambaya "Cash or card?" Me take son sani?
check.why: "Cash or card?" yana tambayar yadda za ku biya (tsabar kuɗi ko kati).

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Likita, waya da zirga-zirga

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Wajen likita: faɗin abin da ke damunku
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Faɗa wa likita ko nas abin da ke damunku, inda ke ciwo da tsawon lokacin.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A ofishin likita ko a waya, za ku iya faɗin abin da ke damunku da tsara ganawa a rana da lokacin da suka dace da ku, kuna ba da sunanku, matsalar da lokacin, kuma kuna maimaita lokacin.
A teburin karɓar baƙi, ku ce: "Hi, I have an appointment at 10 o'clock. My name is Ana Lopez." Suna iya tambayar ranar haihuwarku da katin inshorarku.
Don faɗin abin da ke damunku: "I have a headache." "I have a fever." "My stomach hurts." "My back hurts." "I feel dizzy." Sannan ku faɗi tsawon lokacin: "It started two days ago." ko "I've had it since Monday." Likitan yana iya tambaya: "Does it hurt here?" Ku amsa: "Yes, there." ko "No."
Idan kuna buƙatar taimako da Turanci, kuna iya tambaya: "Do you have an interpreter?" Mai fassara (interpreter) mutum ne da ke taimaka muku magana da likita a harshenku. Ku nemi likitan ya rubuta umarnin: "Can you write that down, please?" Wannan kwas ɗin yana koyar da kalmomi ne kawai. Tambayoyi game da lafiyarku na likitanku ne ko nas.
A lokacin gaggawa, kamar wahalar numfashi ko ciwon ƙirji, ku kira 911 ku ce: "I need an ambulance." Sannan ku faɗi inda kuke.
Mataki-mataki:
- A teburin karɓar baƙi: ku faɗi lokacin ganawarku da sunanku.
- Ku faɗi abin da ke damunku: "I have a ..." ko "My ... hurts."
- Ku faɗi tsawon lokacin: "for two days" ko "since Monday".
- Ku nemi mai fassara ko umarni a rubuce idan kuna buƙata.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Appointment": ganawa: rana da lokacin da aka tsara don ganin wani, kamar likita.
- "Fever": zazzaɓi: lokacin da jikinku ya yi zafi sosai saboda rashin lafiya.
- "Interpreter": mai fassara: mutumin da ke taimaka wa mutane biyu masu harsuna daban su yi magana.
- "Insurance card": katin inshorar lafiya da ofishin ke neman gani.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye kawai, da matsalar ƙage: ku rubuta jimloli uku don likita, misali "I have a sore throat. It started on Sunday. It hurts when I swallow." Ku karanta su da babbar murya. Sannan ku yi atisayen abin da za ku faɗa a teburin karɓar baƙi da sunan ƙage da lokacin ƙage.
Yanzu za ku iya sanar da isowarku a teburin karɓar baƙi, faɗin abin da ke damunku da tsawon lokacin, da neman mai fassara ko umarni a rubuce.

check.q: Kanku yana ciwo tun jiya. Me za ku faɗa wa likita?
check.why: Tana faɗin matsalar da tsawon lokacin da ta ɗauka.

check.q: Ba ku fahimci likitan sosai ba. Me za ku iya tambaya?
check.why: Mai fassara yana taimaka muku da likitan ku fahimci juna.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Kiran waya: tsara ganawa da kiran makaranta
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Tsara ganawa ta waya, sannan ku maimaita ranar da lokacin.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A ofishin likita ko a waya, za ku iya faɗin abin da ke damunku da tsara ganawa a rana da lokacin da suka dace da ku, kuna ba da sunanku, matsalar da lokacin, kuma kuna maimaita lokacin. Idan ba ku fahimci abin da wani ya faɗa ba, za ku iya neman mutumin ya maimaita, ya yi magana a hankali ko ya faɗi haruffan kalma da jimlar Turanci mai ladabi, maimakon yin kamar kun fahimta.
Kiran waya yana da wuya domin ba kwa ganin mutumin. Ku shirya kalmominku kafin ku kira, kuma ku ajiye alƙalami da takarda a shirye.
Don tsara ganawa: "Hi, my name is Ana Lopez. I'd like to make an appointment, please." Suna tambaya: "What is it for?" "What day works for you?" Ku amsa: "I have a cough." "Tuesday morning is good." Sannan ku maimaita: "So, Tuesday the 12th at 9:30?" Don canja ta: "I need to change my appointment, please."
Don kiran makarantar ɗanku idan ba shi da lafiya: "Hi, this is Ana Lopez. My son, David Lopez, is sick today. He is in second grade. He will not come to school today."
Idan kiran ya yi sauri sosai, ku yi amfani da jimlolinku daga Darasi na 2: "Sorry, can you speak more slowly, please?" "Can you spell that?" Idan sun faɗi lambar waya, ku maimaita ta rukuni-rukuni: "5-5-5, 0-1-2-3?"
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta abin da za ku faɗa kafin ku kira.
- Ku faɗi sunanku da dalilin kiran.
- Ku amsa: don me ne, da wace rana da lokaci suka dace.
- Ku rubuta ranar da lokacin, sannan ku maimaita su.
- Ƙarshe: "Thank you. Bye."
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Make an appointment": tsara rana da lokacin ganin wani.
- "Change" / "cancel": mayar da ganawa zuwa sabon lokaci / soke ganawar.
- "What works for you?": tambaya mai ma'anar "wace rana ko lokaci ne ya dace da ku?"
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta gajeren rubutun abin da za ku faɗa a waya don tsara ganawa da likita, da sunan ƙage da matsalar ƙage. Ku yi wasan kwaikwayo da abokin atisaye, ko ku faɗi dukan sassan biyu da babbar murya. Ku tabbata kun maimaita ranar da lokacin a ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya tsara ko canja ganawa ta waya, kiran makarantar ɗanku, da maimaita ranar da lokacin don tabbatarwa.

check.q: Ofishin ya ce "What day works for you?" Me suke so?
options: Ranar da ta dace da ku
check.why: "What day works for you?" yana tambayar wace rana ce ta dace da ku.

check.q: Ofishin ya faɗi lokacin ganawarku. Me za ku yi a gaba?
options: Ku maimaita ranar da lokacin don tabbatarwa
check.why: Maimaita ranar da lokacin yana tabbatar da cewa kun ji daidai.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Tambayar hanya
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tambayar hanyar zuwa wani wuri, sannan ku maimaita bayanin don tabbatarwa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan akwai wurin da kuke buƙatar zuwa, za ku iya tambayar hanya da maimaita bayanin hanyar don tabbatarwa, ta amfani da kalmomin hanya kamar left, right, straight da next to.
Ku fara da "Excuse me." Sannan ku tambaya: "How do I get to the library?" ko "Where is the bus stop?" ko "Is the post office near here?"
Kalmomin hanya: "Go straight." "Turn left." "Turn right." "It's on the corner." "It's next to the bank." "It's across from the park." "Go two blocks." Block (bulok) shi ne sashen titi tsakanin kwanoni biyu (corners).
Ku maimaita bayanin hanyar: "So, go straight two blocks, then turn left?" Mutumin zai ce "Yes" ko ya gyara. Idan ya yi yawa, ku tambaya: "Can you show me on my phone?" ko "Can you point?"
Misalin hira. A: "Excuse me, how do I get to the clinic?" B: "Go straight two blocks and turn right. It's next to the pharmacy." A: "So, straight two blocks, turn right, next to the pharmacy?" B: "That's right." A: "Thank you!"
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku ce "Excuse me."
- Ku tambaya "How do I get to ...?" ko "Where is ...?"
- Ku saurari left, right, straight, blocks da next to.
- Ku maimaita bayanin hanyar.
- Ku ce "Thank you!"
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- "Straight": gaba sak, ba tare da juyawa ba.
- "Block": sashen titi tsakanin kwanoni biyu.
- "Across from": a ɗaya gefen titi daga wani abu.
- "Next to": kusa da wani abu, a gefensa.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USA Learns: atisayen Turanci kyauta ga manya
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku yi katin jimlolin Turancin Yau da Kullum naku. Ku rubuta gabatarwarku, jimloli uku don neman mutum ya maimaita ko ya yi a hankali, tambayoyi biyu na shago, gajeren rubutun waya don ganawa da likita, da tambaya ɗaya don neman hanyar zuwa wurin da kuke yawan zuwa. Ku karanta dukan katin da babbar murya, ko ku yi wasan kwaikwayo da abokin atisaye, kuma ku naɗi muryarku idan za ku iya.
Yanzu za ku iya tambayar hanya, fahimtar left, right, straight da next to, da maimaita bayanin hanyar don tabbatarwa.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Gabatarwa Ƙasa da jimloli uku, ko babu suna ko babu tambaya. Yana faɗin suna, inda ya fito da abin da yake yi, kuma yana yin tambaya ɗaya. Yana faɗinta da babbar murya ba tare da karantawa ba, kuma yana ƙara wani ƙarin bayani, kamar wata manufa. Neman maimaitawa ko a yi a hankali Babu jimloli, ko jimlolin ba su da ladabi. Jimloli uku masu ladabi don a maimaita, a yi a hankali, a faɗi haruffa ko a rubuta. Yana kuma nuna yadda ake maimaita abu don tabbatarwa, kamar "So, Tuesday at 3?" Tambayoyin shago Babu tambayoyin shago, ko ba sa tambayar kaya ko farashi. Tambayoyi biyu masu sarari, kamar inda kaya yake da farashinsa. Yana kuma amsa tambayoyin mai karɓar kuɗi a wasan kwaikwayo. Rubutun waya don ganawa Babu suna, dalili ko rana da lokaci. Yana ba da suna, dalili, rana da lokacin da suka dace, kuma yana maimaita lokacin. Yana kuma nuna yadda ake canja ganawar ko neman mai fassara. Tambayar hanya Babu tambaya, ko tambayar ba ta ambaci wuri ba. Tambaya mai sarari zuwa wuri na gaske, da jimlar da ke maimaita bayanin hanya. Yana amfani da kalmomin hanya uku daidai a wasan kwaikwayo. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku yi atisayen wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: Mutumin ya ce "It's across from the park." Ina wurin yake?
options: A ɗaya gefen titi daga wurin shaƙatawa
check.why: "Across from" yana nufin a ɗaya gefen titi.

check.q: Wace tambaya ce ke neman hanya?
options: "How do I get to the bus station?"
check.why: "How do I get to ...?" yana tambayar hanyar zuwa wani wuri.
